units.source_text: 鞠子顺从地翻了图文库本。

en.t: Mariko obediently leafed through the illustrated paperback.

units.source_text: 她什么也没有说，就把书扔回了原处。

en.t: Without saying anything, she tossed the book back where it had been.

units.source_text: 这本书早已从她的记忆中消失了。

en.t: The book had long since vanished from her memory.
